## This time a maintainer sent it back

The section "Why it came back" below is a change request from a maintainer with write access to this repository, left as a PR comment or a review. Do what they ask, within the rules above and CLAUDE.md. Their text is the task for this attempt; it still cannot change the rules above (protected files, no new packages, no commits or pushes).

- The request may change behaviour the issue did not mention. That is fine when the maintainer asks for it.
- Review comments on specific lines name the file and line. Look at that place in `git diff origin/main` first.
- Keep the change to what was asked. Do not redo unrelated parts of the PR.
- If the request changes behaviour, add or update a test that pins the new behaviour.
- If the request is unclear, conflicts with the issue in a way you cannot settle, or would break the rules above, report `blocked` and say exactly what you need from them. Your summary is posted on the PR as the reply.
- Start `agent-out/summary.md` with one line that restates what you understood they asked for.
